d: Mantis is a leading, conservation-focused hotel group with eco-lodges, waterways and eco-escapes located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco-tourism, safaris and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.

Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach-side escape or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass-produces sameness.

The General Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, commercial success, operational performance and financial management of Gamra by Mantis, an experiential mountain resort in the Al-Baha region of Saudi Arabia. As the property leader, the General Manager is accountable for delivering memorable guest experiences, driving sustainable profitability, developing local talent and ensuring that the resort operates in alignment with Mantis and Accor brand standards.

The role requires a visible, hands-on and commercially astute hospitality leader who can establish a strong operational foundation, lead and develop an effective Executive Committee, and ensure that each department is professionally managed by competent and accountable Department Heads.

The General Manager will provide clear direction, oversight and performance accountability, while empowering Department Heads to take ownership of the day-to-day management and delivery of their respective functions.

Working closely with ownership, Mantis and Accor corporate leadership, the General Manager will continue to develop Gamra as a recognised and commercially successful experiential destination, building strong relationships with local stakeholders and the surrounding community.
q: Ensure the delivery of exceptional, consistent and memorable guest experiences that reflect the unique identity and service philosophy of Gamra by Mantis.
Ensure guest journeys are thoughtfully designed around the resort's mountain setting, experiential offering and target markets.
Monitor guest feedback, satisfaction and loyalty indicators, ensuring that Department Heads address service gaps and drive improvement.
Personally engage with guests and VIP visitors when appropriate, acting on feedback and championing a guest-centric culture.
Champion the Mantis environmental and sustainability philosophy and ensure responsible operating practices are embedded throughout the resort.
Oversee the property's approach to responsible resource use, including energy, water, waste and other environmental impacts.
Ensure the resort operates respectfully within its natural setting and contributes positively to the surrounding environment and community.
Build meaningful relationships with local communities and stakeholders, supporting local employment, supplier development and community-based initiatives where appropriate.
Ensure sustainability and responsible tourism principles are reflected in the guest experience and departmental practices.
Deliver budgeted revenue, GOP, EBITDA and cash flow targets.
Lead the annual operating and capital expenditure budgeting process, ensuring appropriate input and accountability from Department Heads.
Ensure accurate forecasting, financial planning and performance reporting, taking timely corrective action where required.
Maintain effective cost control, procurement oversight, inventory management and internal controls while protecting the guest experience.
Review financial and operational results with Department Heads and ensure that agreed actions are implemented.
Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi Arabian legislation, labour regulations, licensing requirements, company policies and Mantis/Accor standards.
Maintain strong internal controls, ethical business practices and corporate governance.
r: Develop and execute the property's short and long term strategic plans in alignment with owner and Mantis objectives.
Lead the Executive Committee and establish a clear direction, priorities and performance expectations for all departments.
Foster a high-performance culture built around accountability, collaboration, innovation and guest-centricity.
Champion the Mantis brand values and sustainability philosophy throughout the employee and guest journeys.
Lead change and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring that business priorities are translated into practical departmental action.
Build, lead and develop a capable, engaged and accountable Executive Committee and wider team.

Ensure Department Heads take responsibility for recruitment, induction, training, performance management, employee engagement and development within their respective departments, supported by People & Culture.

Drive overall commercial performance across accommodation, food and beverage, and other revenue streams.
Develop the commercial potential of the resort as both an accommodation destination and a visitor experience for the regional and domestic market.
Ensure effective pricing, inventory management, forecasting and revenue management strategies in collaboration with the Mantis team.
Identify new business opportunities that strengthen revenue and market positioning while remaining aligned with the property's identity and brand standards.

Lead the property's commercial priorities in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management and Distribution teams.
Support initiatives to increase brand awareness, market penetration and guest acquisition across relevant domestic, regional and international source markets.
Support digital marketing, public relations, partnerships and destination promotion initiatives.
Monitor competitor performance, market trends, tourism developments and guest feedback, using market intelligence to inform business decisions.
Provide overall leadership, direction and oversight of all operational departments, ensuring that each is effectively managed by competent and accountable Department Heads.

Ensure consistent implementation of brand standards, operational policies, SOPs and best

d: An Infrastructure Engineer / Cloud Engineer designs, deploys, automates, and maintains the core cloud and on-premise IT systems that keep applications reliable, secure, and scalable
Cloud & Virtualization Management: Deploy, configure, and manage cloud environments (such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OpenStack), virtual machines, storage, and compute resources.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Write IaC scripts using tools like Terraform or Ansible to automate provisioning and reduce manual deployment errors.
CI/CD & DevOps Support: Help build and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines alongside development and SRE teams.
System Administration & Networking: Administer Linux/Windows servers, manage packages and file systems, and configure network interfaces, VLANs, load balancers, and firewalls.
Monitoring & Incident Response: Track system health, resource utilization, and uptime dashboards, troubleshoot outages, and resolve infrastructure incidents.
Security & Compliance: Implement security best practices, manage identity and access
q: Technical Experience: 6+ years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or cloud engineering.
Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud (GCP) , or private cloud stacks like OpenStack .
Scripting & IaC: Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python) and configuration/automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker).
Operating Systems: Strong command of Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and/or Windows Server administration.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
The Compliance Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day execution of Bybit's global compliance operations programme.

Working across multiple licensed jurisdictions, you will help ensure regulatory commitments are translated into practical operating processes, tracked effectively, and maintained throughout the licence lifecycle. This role works closely with Legal, Licensing, Product, Operations and regional teams to support operational readiness and ongoing compliance activities.
q: 2 - 4 years experience in Compliance Operations, Regulatory Operations, Project Management Office or a similar operational role within financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
Experience coordinating cross-functional projects or operational initiatives, working with stakeholders across different functions and jurisdictions
Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, follow through on deliverables and work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to develop clear SOPs, process documentation and management reports.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
Crypto or digital asset experience is advantageous but not essential.
Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.
Mandarin proficiency is advantageous to support collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
Passionate about cryptocurrency and financial innovation.
Highly organised with strong follow-through and execution discipline.
Collaborative and comfortable working with legal, product, operations and business stakeholders.
Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation quality and operational efficiency.
r: Manage the tracking of regulatory obligations, licensing conditions and operational actions, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
Coordinate the operational implementation of new licences, including developing SOPs, implementation checklists and business readiness materials in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
Monitor adherence to compliance operational processes, proactively identifying, managing and escalating risks or overdue actions.
Prepare operational reports, implementation updates and management briefing materials for senior stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional regulatory implementation activities with Legal, Licensing, Product, Operations and regional teams.
Support audits, regulatory inspections and operational reviews by coordinating documentation, evidence gathering and remediation tracking.
Conduct operational gap assessments, identify areas for improvement and drive remediation initiatives to strengthen compliance processes and controls.
